Value: NXP TJA1051 (marking 25 06 ND312); no substitution; pin-5 variant unconfirmed

Purpose: Holds S HIGH (Silent) from the transceiver's own rail; F2/F5. Drop at 10 uA max IIH = 0.1 V.
Holds TXD recessive (HIGH) because GPIO21 is not connected; supplements the internal pull-up.
RXD divider bottom: 4.5 V -> 2.81 V, 5.0 V -> 3.13 V, 5.5 V -> 3.44 V.
U1 local decoupling, placed at pins 3/2; F6.
Split termination - fit ONLY when this node is a bus end of an isolated bench bus; F7.
